data.gender_notes: Izz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The word Izz refers to glory, greatness, or honor in Arabic. It is a unisex name that is popular in several cultures. In Islamic tradition, Izz is associated with the concept of Allah's greatness and power. The name Izz carries the meaning “Glory, Greatness, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izz usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, greatness, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the greatness and glory of Allah.
data.etymology: Izz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory, Greatness, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
